description.value: Walmart Supercentre is a large-format retail store in Chilliwack's Eagle Landing area, offering a full grocery department alongside general merchandise including electronics, clothing, and household goods. As a supercentre format, it is one of the most comprehensive one-stop shopping destinations in the region for a touring cyclist needing to restock supplies. The OSM record indicates 24/7 operation.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record clearly identifies this as a Walmart Supercentre (shop=supermarket) at 8249 Eagle Landing Parkway, Chilliwack, with a brand tag confirming it is part of the Walmart chain. The website partially loaded and its title confirms 'grocery, Electronics, Toys, Clothing, Furniture, Baby | Store 3167', corroborating the grocery category and store existence. Most subpages returned anti-bot challenges, so detailed amenity confirmation from the website is not possible; all amenities except basic groceries remain null.
